cases.mechanism_detail: An ~2.5-kb SVA inserted in exon 5 of MSH6 induced aberrant splicing detected by mRNA sequencing; one of the two SVAs studied is present in a Japanese reference genome (polymorphic), which one is not stated in the abstract.
cases.quote: Both of these insertions induced aberrant splicing, and these variants were successfully identified by mRNA sequencing or visual observation of mapping results
